Hi Zecharia,
Thanks for the note. I'd be happy to chat with your and your colleagues next week. We've grown our government
partnerships pretty dramatically since 2019, in large part focused on COVID-19 response. We now have government
partners across 60 countries.
Unfortunately, we don't yet have any US federal government partners, but we are in advanced conversations about
launching a project with the CDC and we're engaged with their legal teams on the compliance side.
While we don't have a separate terms sheet for federal space, many government clients have been able to accept
our business terms and privacy policy and we have developer partners who also have deep experience in the
government space.
Anyhow, curious to learn more about what type of project / partnership you have in mind and happy to chat live next
week.
Many thanks.
Ben
